purpose: Rear-facing playable witch flight sprites matching the existing boss sheets

runtime.registration: Hand-registered source row bands and alpha bounds; common scale and stable baseline. Nearest-neighbour rendering after one atlas reduction.
runtime.directionCorrection: Marisa southeast pair mirrored horizontally because its generated bank leaned west.

artwork.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent animated sprite sheet for a vertical 1990s Japanese STG / GBA game.
Input image: supplied boss sprite sheet is STYLE AND CHARACTER DESIGN REFERENCE ONLY. Create a new rear-view player sprite sheet; do not reuse its front-facing poses.
Primary request: a compact airborne player character SEEN FROM BEHIND, flying toward the top of the screen. Match the reference's crisp coloured outline, limited soft palette and clean pixel clusters. The character must face AWAY in EVERY frame. No visible eyes, face or chest. This is flying, not standing; trailing hair, cape and skirt, feet lifted behind.
Composition: EXACTLY 18 isolated frames on a regular 6-column by 3-row grid, landscape canvas 2:1. Equal square cells. Two consecutive flutter frames for each of nine movement states. Order row 1: idle A, idle B, north A, north B, northeast A, northeast B. Row 2: east A, east B, southeast A, southeast B, south A, south B. Row 3: southwest A, southwest B, west A, west B, northwest A, northwest B. The two frames of a state differ only in small hair/skirt flutter; stable torso anchor, identical proportions and scale. North leans forward; south brakes while still facing away; east/west bank noticeably toward the corresponding screen side; diagonals combine forward/braking posture with bank. Do not rotate the entire sprite like a flat sticker.
Style: genuine small-game pixel art, logical 48x48-pixel cell, silhouette around 28x36 logical pixels, roughly 2.5 heads tall, only 16–24 colours, solid square clusters, coloured single-pixel outer contour, two or three shade values per material. Enlarged nearest-neighbour pixel appearance. No painted texture, no soft shading or antialiasing. All sprites same scale, exactly centred per cell, nothing touches cell edges.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha. No ground shadows, no glow, no motion streaks, no scenery, no cell borders, no text, no labels, no watermarks. No extra characters or floating companions. Keep empty padding narrow and regular.
Subject: Alice Margatroid. Short golden blonde bob seen from the back, thin red headband visible over the crown; blue dress, white shoulder cape across her back, white skirt frill, brown boots. Her front red neck ribbon must NOT appear as a large bow on her back. Arms slightly away from her sides in controlled magical flight, no broom, no hat, no book.
